title: Ship Dễ Governed Ecosystem Toolchain Manifest
description: Authoritative catalog of adopted repositories, capabilities, and pilot candidates governed by role separation, minimal profile activation, and fail-closed safety.

policies.AI-TOOL-01: Installed does not imply integrated, enabled or blocking.
policies.AI-TOOL-02: Optional services and MCP servers are stopped by default and after profile completion.
policies.AI-TOOL-03: Only one implementation agent and one research agent may run concurrently; the same Work Item never has parallel writers.
policies.AI-TOOL-04: 9Router is localhost-only, authenticated, request logging/cloud sync off, and never routes Codex review verdicts.
policies.AI-TOOL-05: Skills/content are commit-pinned, admission-scanned and loaded only by task trigger; no blanket prompt injection.
policies.AI-TOOL-06: Hermes memory and self-created skills are untrusted until human-reviewed into shipde-brain; no PII or credential persistence.
policies.AI-TOOL-07: Playwright Test is acceptance evidence; Playwright CLI is token-efficient agent interaction; Playwright MCP is stateful exploration; Chrome DevTools MCP is deep runtime diagnosis.
policies.AI-TOOL-08: MSW owns behavioral mocks and Prism owns schema validation. Neither silently becomes production carrier evidence.
policies.AI-TOOL-09: Community Vietnamese address data is a versioned input, not legal or carrier source of truth; import requires provenance and validation.
policies.AI-TOOL-10: A failed or partial installation reports exact state and rollback; it must not be recorded as installed or healthy.
policies.AI-TOOL-11: A supplied authoritative version/ref/path is fail closed; no fallback to latest, another branch or a broader filesystem path.
policies.AI-TOOL-12: GitHub merged state is reconciled by PR identity and merge SHA; repeated synchronization is a no-op and never rewrites unrelated rows.

orchestrator_runtime.name: Agent Orchestrator
orchestrator_runtime.role: Supervise one implementation agent and one research agent, isolate worktrees, and route governed CI/review lifecycle events.
orchestrator_runtime.source_of_truth_boundary: External control layer around the adopted ecosystem; it is not counted as an adopted Ship De repository or provider.
orchestrator_runtime.activation_rule: Start only through scripts/ai/start-agent-orchestrator.ps1 when Resume or Supervise requires it.
